relationships.subject: oxytocin
relationships.evidence_quote: Repeated intranasal OT administration and AAV9-mediated OT overexpression in either the PVN or NTS significantly reduced CGRP expression, neuronal activation, and pro-inflammatory cytokine levels (IL-1α, IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α) in the NTS, and alleviated hyperalgesic behaviors.

key_findings: OT is upregulated in PVN and NTS in late pregnancy, with PVN-to-NTS oxytocinergic projections, in a pregnant chronic migraine rat model.
OT reduces NTS CGRP, pro-inflammatory cytokines and hyperalgesia by downregulating ECM-receptor interaction signaling and integrin receptors.
